title: Route First, See Later: Enabling Vision Agents to Reason Scientifically by Separating Routing Policy from Action Spaces
abstract: arXiv:2611.06760v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scientific image-analysis workflows require agents to select among diverse capabilities like description, detection, counting, and segmentation. Current multi-tool architectures conflate intent interpretation with visual execution, masking whether a failure arises from flawed reasoning (misrouting) or failed perception (invalid tool execution). This lack of auditability renders agents unreliable for high-stakes scientific automation. We introduce ZETA, an extensible architecture that operationalizes the decoupling of routing policy from action execution. ZETA resolves scientific intent before invoking specialized visual tools, treating measurement as a deterministic operation grounded in explicit geometry rather than generative output. This architecture exposes the "black box" of agent decision-making, allowing routing correctness and downstream execution to be evaluated as independent failure modes. translated_title: 先路由，后观察：通过将路由策略与动作空间分离，使视觉智能体能够进行科学推理
translated_abstract: 科学图像分析工作流要求智能体在描述、检测、计数和分割等多种能力中进行选择。当前的多工具架构将意图解释与视觉执行混为一谈，从而掩盖了失败究竟源于有缺陷的推理（错误路由）还是失败的感知（无效的工具执行）。这种可审计性的缺失使得智能体在高风险的科学自动化场景中不可靠。我们提出了ZETA，这是一种可扩展的架构，实现了路由策略与动作执行的解耦。ZETA在调用专用视觉工具之前先解析科学意图，将测量视为基于显式几何的确定性操作，而非生成式输出。该架构揭示了智能体决策过程的“黑箱”，使路由正确性和下游执行可以作为相互独立的失败模式分别进行评估。据我们所知，我们提供了……
tldr: 提出ZETA架构，通过将路由策略与视觉工具执行解耦，让智能体先解析科学意图再调用专用工具，并将测量建立在显式几何之上，从而将推理错误与感知失败作为独立失败模式进行审计评估，提升科学图像分析自动化的可靠性。
en_tdlr: ZETA is an extensible architecture that decouples routing policy from action execution, resolving scientific intent before invoking specialized visual tools and grounding measurement in explicit geometry, thereby exposing agent decision-making and enabling routing correctness and downstream execution to be evaluated as independent failure modes for reliable scientific automation.
